headlines.text: That Friday in 2023, Jamie Hayter vs. Emi Sakura met in an Eliminator Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 8.15 ? one of the better matches of the year. Sakura, a wrestler Hayter deeply respects, pushed the champion to her limit in a title eliminator before three Exploder suplexes and a Ripcord lariat retained Hayter's reign.

2024 brought us this moment: FTR & Garcia vs. House of Black fought it out in an Escape the Cage Elimination match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 8.22 ? an excellent showing in a fast-paced six-man clash. FTR and Garcia outlasted House of Black in a brutal elimination steel cage match, with Mark Briscoe slamming the cage door on Malakai Black to secure Garcia's escape and the win.
Back on this day in 2021, it marked the first-ever meeting between Jungle Boy and Dax Harwood on Dynamite, rated 7.85 ? a good, competitive contest.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Collision stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.25.

On this day in 2021, The Good Brothers vs. The Young Bucks vs. Dark Order (Grayson & Uno) vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) vs. Karl Anderson vs. Luke Gallows vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Evil Uno vs. Stu Grayson vs. Alex Reynolds vs. John Silver closed out Dynamite, rated 7.52 ? a solid showing.
Turning the clock back to 2024: it was the first-ever encounter between Bryan Danielson and Yuji Nagata on Collision, rated 7.65 ? a good, competitive contest.
